limitations: Evidence class: software verification on ref-x86-64 (TRS2) under id S15a; the claims RID.A01-A12 are checked over finite sets (ADR 0074 section 6) and section 2.1 argues the rest. No local full gate was run; the merge condition is the CI run recorded in RID.C1. An id is bookkeeping: this is not validation, verification of a model, or review evidence.

O-3 (ADR 0074 section 8, open): nothing ties a line file's evidence_package to its line. A 0.5 line file that inherits 0.4 without changing evidence_package keeps REL040, and RP.L03 does not refuse an equal field. RP amendment RP.L11 (gate_set.evidence_package equals ADR 0074 D2's id of the line X.Y with .0 appended) is due before the 0.5 line file is written; it cannot bite before then, since the only gate line is 0.4.

O-4 (ADR 0074 section 8, open): ADR 0055 D1 item 5 carries the same plain-digits wording. RP is the normative text, so A-9 governs. When K-2 marks ADR 0055 Accepted, the marker adds the pointer 'the mapping is ADR 0074 D2 (RP A-9)'. ADR 0074 does not edit ADR 0055.

O-5 (ADR 0074 section 8, recommended no change): a string with a trailing newline passes every work_package alternative under re.search ($ matches before a final newline), REL040 and S13 included. This is pre-existing and shared; test_manifest_path_matches_contents makes it unreachable for a committed manifest. Refusing it would narrow all alternatives and needs its own ADR.

Not established (ADR 0074 section 3): that a line file names the right id (O-3); that a patch line (0.4.1 to REL041) is a release package under RP, since RP section 2.2 still requires an amendment for patch lines; that a trailing newline is refused (O-5); any validation, verification or review evidence.
